_comment: The strict Bash permission variant from the 2026-07-31 security audit remediation (P0: interpreter allow entries let `bash -c ...` bypass every deny and ask pattern). Applied briefly on 2026-08-01 and rolled back the same day by Ian: the approval friction outweighed the risk for daily solo work. Kept here as the documented swap-in. To adopt: replace the allow/ask arrays in settings.json with these (deny stays identical either way). The residual risk of the lenient list is recorded in ISSUES.md.
